ClaimSecure
IT Administrator

The IT Administrator maintains and supports the company's core infrastructure, business systems, and end-user technology. This role partners with the ClaimSecure operations team to keep services reliable, secure, documented, and recoverable.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Administer Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Windows Server, and user access.
- Monitor backups, virtualization, VMware hosts, and network availability.
- Resolve helpdesk incidents and document recurring technical issues.
- Maintain endpoint security, patching, asset inventory, and disaster-recovery procedures.
- Support business applications, vendor integrations, and secure data transfers.
- Build operational dashboards and reports for service-level trends.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience administering Active Directory and Windows Server.
- Practical Microsoft 365 administration and troubleshooting experience.
- Knowledge of networking, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, firewalls, and endpoint security.
- Experience with VMware, backups, disaster recovery, and helpdesk workflows.
- Clear documentation and stakeholder communication skills.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- PowerShell or Python automation experience.
- Familiarity with SQL reporting and dashboard development.

To apply, send a resume to careers@claimsecure.com.
ClaimSecure is committed to an inclusive and accessible recruitment process.
